en: The CSV file has an unclosed quote; it may be cut off or edited. No rows were imported.
sl: Datoteka CSV ima nezaprt narekovaj; morda je odrezana ali urejena. Nobena vrstica ni bila uvožena.

en: The CSV file could not be opened or did not match the expected Trade Republic format.
sl: Datoteke CSV ni bilo mogoče odpreti ali ne ustreza pričakovani obliki Trade Republic.

en: A row with the wrong number of fields contains a line break inside a field; a quote is probably unclosed. No rows were imported.
sl: Vrstica z napačnim številom polj vsebuje prelom vrstice znotraj polja; narekovaj je verjetno nezaprt. Nobena vrstica ni bila uvožena.

en: The columns are separated by semicolons or tabs, not commas; the file was probably opened and saved again in a spreadsheet program. Download the export again from Trade Republic and import it unchanged. No rows were imported.
sl: Stolpci so ločeni s podpičji ali tabulatorji, ne z vejicami; datoteka je bila verjetno odprta in ponovno shranjena v programu za preglednice. Izvoz znova prenesite iz Trade Republic in ga uvozite nespremenjenega. Nobena vrstica ni bila uvožena.

en: The file is not a Trade Republic transaction export. Required columns are missing: {count} ({columns}). No rows were imported.
sl: Datoteka ni izvoz transakcij Trade Republic. Manjkajoči obvezni stolpci: {count} ({columns}). Nobena vrstica ni bila uvožena.

en: The row has a different number of fields than the header (expected {expected}, found {found}); the row was skipped.
sl: Vrstica ima drugačno število polj kot glava (pričakovano {expected}, najdeno {found}); vrstica je bila preskočena.

en: {rowCount} rows have a number with a comma or parentheses, which Trade Republic does not export; the file was probably opened and saved again in a spreadsheet program. Download the export again from Trade Republic and import it unchanged.
sl: Število vrstic s številom z vejico ali oklepaji, ki jih Trade Republic ne izvozi: {rowCount}. Datoteka je bila verjetno odprta in ponovno shranjena v programu za preglednice. Izvoz znova prenesite iz Trade Republic in ga uvozite nespremenjenega.

en: Required field 'datetime' is missing; transaction order cannot be established. The row was skipped; review the source transaction.
sl: Zahtevano polje 'datetime' manjka; vrstnega reda transakcij ni mogoče določiti. Vrstica je bila preskočena; preverite izvorno transakcijo.

en: Required field '{field}' is missing in {rowKind}; the row was skipped.
sl: Zahtevano polje '{field}' manjka (vrsta vrstice: {rowKind}); vrstica je bila preskočena.

en: Required fields 'symbol' and 'name' are missing in {rowKind}; the row was skipped.
sl: Zahtevani polji 'symbol' in 'name' manjkata (vrsta vrstice: {rowKind}); vrstica je bila preskočena.

en: Display name is missing; the identified event was retained.
sl: Prikazno ime manjka; prepoznani dogodek je bil ohranjen.

en: Asset classification is unresolved; the event was retained.
sl: Klasifikacija sredstva ni razrešena; dogodek je bil ohranjen.

en: Field 'datetime' is invalid; exact transaction order is unknown. The event retains its tax date and uses deterministic source ordering.
sl: Polje 'datetime' je neveljavno; natančen vrstni red transakcij ni znan. Dogodek ohrani davčni datum in uporablja določen vrstni red glede na vir.

en: Field '{field}' has an invalid value in {rowKind}; the row was skipped.
sl: Polje '{field}' ima neveljavno vrednost (vrsta vrstice: {rowKind}); vrstica je bila preskočena.

en: The calendar date in 'datetime' differs from 'date'; reporting uses 'date' and ordering uses that date at the default hour {defaultHour}:00:00 UTC. The original timestamp is retained. FIFO or corporate-action order may be incorrect; review the transaction order.
sl: Koledarski datum v polju 'datetime' se razlikuje od polja 'date'; poročanje uporablja 'date', vrstni red pa ta datum ob privzeti uri {defaultHour}:00:00 UTC. Izvirni časovni žig je ohranjen. Vrstni red FIFO ali korporativnih dejanj je lahko napačen; preverite vrstni red transakcij.

en: Field '{field}' is inconsistent with the trade side; the row was skipped.
sl: Polje '{field}' ni skladno z vrsto posla (nakup ali prodaja); vrstica je bila preskočena.

en: Asset classes differ for the same ISIN; events were retained with unresolved classification.
sl: Razredi sredstev se za isti ISIN razlikujejo; dogodki so bili ohranjeni z nerazrešeno klasifikacijo.

en: Asset classification is unresolved; the event was retained.
sl: Klasifikacija sredstva ni razrešena; dogodek je bil ohranjen.

en: Asset class '{assetClass}' was preserved, but its tax treatment is not supported yet.
sl: Razred sredstva '{assetClass}' je ohranjen, vendar njegova davčna obravnava še ni podprta.

en: The interest row has no verified cash-interest or bond-coupon mapping; the row was skipped.
sl: Vrstica obresti nima preverjene preslikave v obresti na gotovino ali kupon obveznice; vrstica je bila preskočena.

en: Transaction type '{type}' in category '{category}' is recognized but not supported; the row was skipped.
sl: Vrsta transakcije '{type}' v kategoriji '{category}' je prepoznana, vendar ni podprta; vrstica je bila preskočena.

en: This interest transaction type is not supported; the row was skipped.
sl: Ta vrsta obrestne transakcije ni podprta; vrstica je bila preskočena.

en: Transaction type '{type}' in category '{category}' is unknown; the row was skipped.
sl: Vrsta transakcije '{type}' v kategoriji '{category}' ni znana; vrstica je bila preskočena.

en: Multiple merge inputs use the same source index; their events were not merged.
sl: Več vhodov za združevanje uporablja isti indeks vira; njihovi dogodki niso bili združeni.

en: An event has no source reference and was not merged.
sl: Dogodek nima sklica na vir in ni bil združen.

en: An event source index does not match its merge input and was not merged.
sl: Indeks vira dogodka se ne ujema z vhodom za združevanje in dogodek ni bil združen.

en: Events with the same broker transaction ID have conflicting tax-relevant data and were not merged.
sl: Dogodki z enakim ID-jem transakcije pri brokerju imajo nasprotujoče si davčno pomembne podatke in niso bili združeni.

en: The same transaction appears more than once in one file; it was counted once. Check the export for a copy error.
sl: Ista transakcija se v eni datoteki pojavi večkrat; upoštevana je bila enkrat. Preverite, ali je v izvozu napaka pri kopiranju.

en: Instrument names differ for the same identity; the earliest non-empty name is used for presentation; blank source names remain evidence.
sl: Imena instrumenta se za isto identiteto razlikujejo; za prikaz je uporabljeno najzgodnejše neprazno ime; prazna imena v virih ostanejo kot dokaz.

en: Asset classes differ for the same ISIN; the merged asset class is unknown.
sl: Razredi sredstev se za isti ISIN razlikujejo; združeni razred sredstva je neznan.

en: The value cannot be represented at the required precision or range.
sl: Vrednosti ni mogoče predstaviti z zahtevano natančnostjo ali v zahtevanem obsegu.

en: The calculation exceeds the supported integer range.
sl: Izračun presega podprti celoštevilski obseg.

en: The exchange rate is invalid.
sl: Menjalni tečaj je neveljaven.

en: The corporate action cannot preserve the position and exact basis.
sl: Korporativno dejanje ne more ohraniti stanja in natančne nabavne vrednosti.

en: Select a reporting year from {minYear} to {maxYear}.
sl: Izberite poročevalsko leto od {minYear} do {maxYear}.

en: Earlier purchase history is missing: this sale needs more units than the earlier purchases left. Add the older or missing statements.
sl: Manjka zgodovina prejšnjih nakupov: ta prodaja potrebuje več enot, kot jih je ostalo od prejšnjih nakupov. Dodajte starejše ali manjkajoče izpiske.

en: The value of the XML field {field} is outside what the FURS form allows: wrong length or format, a negative number, or characters the form does not accept. No XML file was written for this form.
sl: Vrednost polja XML {field} je zunaj tega, kar dovoljuje obrazec FURS: napačna dolžina ali oblika, negativno število ali znaki, ki jih obrazec ne sprejme. Datoteka XML za ta obrazec ni bila ustvarjena.
